'''Brixians''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="TLJ" /> that originated from the [[Brix system]].<ref name="Appendix" /> The [[Butcher of Brix]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Art_of_TLJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
Brixians possessed [[Color|black]], [[chitin]]ous skin with a white-fronted torso that had a red strip down the middle. They also had four red [[eye]]s and [[spider]]-like [[Mouth|mandibles]].<ref name="Topps" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species known as the [[Butcher of Brix]]<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" /> was present on the [[planet]] [[Daiyu]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]<ref name="Kenobi II">{{Kenobi|Part II}}</ref> in [[9 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Kenobi|Part II}} to [[9 BBY]].</ref> The Butcher stood with two [[human]]s in one of Daiyu's streets when the [[spice dealer]] [[Tetha Grig]] offered [[spice]] to the [[Jedi]]-in-hiding [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] nearby.<ref name="Kenobi II" /> Later, in [[34 ABY]], the Butcher of Brix was a patron of<ref name="TLJ" /> the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ VD">''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The warlord was stood at one of the [[casino]]'s [[gambling]] tables beside a [[Namara]] in a white [[Clothing|dress]] when the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]], [[Rose Tico]], and [[BB-8]] entered the establishment while [[Mission to Canto Bight|searching]] for the [[Master Codebreaker]]. The Butcher was then stood by a different table with fellow patron<ref name="TLJ" /> [[Snook Uccorfay]]<ref name="TLJ VD" /> when the drunken patron [[Dobbu Scay]] accosted BB-8.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The warlord had two very beautiful ladies by his side, all the time. He's fully animatronic; there's no performer in him. Super-slime dripping from his mouth, caught in a glass very delicately by a lady.|[[Neal Scanlan]]|<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" />}}
[[File:ButcherOfBrix.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art for King 11 by Ivan Manzella]]
The Brixians were created for the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> Concept art of the character titled "King 11" was created by creature concept designer [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Art_of_TLJ" />
